summary: The change only affects how the dev-only playtest CLI reports results. formatStyleReport now judges a mixed spot only when recommended + alternative >= MIN_JUDGED_DECISIONS (10) and lists rarer spots as not judged. The --check-styles usage text, tests and docs are updated to match. No new untrusted input. Report strings come from internal style and spot enums and integer counts. Existing CLI argument parsing is unchanged. No shell, file or path operations, no new dependency, and no change to randomness or seeds. On failing closed: spots with 10 or more decisions are still failed when only one action was used, and the exit code still depends on outside + oneAction. Not-judged spots cannot hide a band failure. Agrees with spec section 8 (N/A).
